3 OCTOBER 2026 / INSPO-ONLY DESIGN RESEARCH

A simulator people can understand

Best overall: Dovetail’s research workspace, adapted to a light, calm interface. Its captured view connects filtered results to named themes and inspectable records.

Five topical searches yielded 43 unique results; 16 full captures were compared; nine references and three reusable templates were shortlisted.

REFERENCE 01 / MAIN RESEARCH WORKSPACE AND INSIGHT REVIEW

Dovetail: Filterable chart + theme list + data points

Marketing page with a detailed embedded analytics view. Captured 2026-05-04. Detail crop from the full Inspo screenshot.

Show marketing context

Observed pattern

One captured product view combines a research theme chart, a date range, a Themes / Data points switch, a count of selected themes and points, and a corresponding item list. Names connect the visualization to the underlying records.

Apply to wcEcoli

Use this pattern as the central Analyze workspace: compare result groups above, then keep the contributing runs and conditions in a linked table. Make the selected interval and number of included runs explicit. Treat the list as a route to inspect raw evidence.

Evidence limit

Best overall reference for a research workspace, not a full simulation application. The captured product is for customer feedback; its revenue labels and dark grid do not transfer to cell biology. It does not show a setup or teaching flow.

REFERENCE 02 / EXPERIMENT METRIC AND VARIANT OVERVIEW

Statsig: Test framing + summary metrics + comparison charts

Marketing page with floating experiment analytics cards. Captured 2026-05-14.

Observed pattern

The page frames the product around testing each release and pairs the headline with dashboard cards containing metrics and comparison charts. The compact top navigation and plain copy are easier to scan than a dense tool interface.

Apply to wcEcoli

Borrow only the framing: state the question or variant comparison, then label outcomes and cohorts directly. For the simulator, name the baseline and altered condition and keep units and seeds visible.

Evidence limit

The dashboard is a tilted marketing preview. No experiment configuration, statistical method, uncertainty explanation, or run history is legible or verified. It is a focused concept reference, not the overall app template.

REFERENCE 03 / EXPERIMENT AND BATCH CATALOG

Smartsheet: Aligned table + local toolbar

Marketing page with embedded project table. Captured 2026-05-04. Detail crop from the full Inspo screenshot.

Show marketing context

Observed pattern

The project plan has aligned columns for task, description, risk, assignee, and status. A toolbar puts table controls, search, and filtering directly above the rows. A compact icon rail sits beside the table.

Apply to wcEcoli

List experiment name, variant, condition, seeds, status, and updated time. Keep search and filters next to the catalog. Let a row open its details, and make compare selection explicit. Pair any icon navigation with text labels.

Evidence limit

This is a small product preview. Sorting, bulk selection, pagination, and editing were not exercised. A research catalog should avoid adopting every spreadsheet control.

REFERENCE 04 / RUN MONITORING

Buildkite Pipelines: Stage checklist + overall run state

Product marketing page with embedded pipeline card. Captured 2026-05-12. Detail crop from the full Inspo screenshot.

Show marketing context

Observed pattern

A pipeline card identifies a run and branch, states Passed in 5s, and shows named steps with check marks. The overall result is separated from individual steps. A Rebuild action remains local to that run.

Apply to wcEcoli

Show actual backend stages such as preparation, simulation, and analysis only where supported. Display elapsed time and state in text. Open logs from a selected stage. Explain failures in plain language and retain configuration for a deliberate retry.

Evidence limit

Only a successful build is pictured. Queued, active, partial, and failed states are design requirements for wcEcoli, not observed examples. Do not invent progress percentages.

Glyphs Tutorials: Search + topic filters + starter path

Captured tutorial and learning index. Captured 2026-09-10.

Observed pattern

The page places a large search field above topic filters and tutorial cards. A prominent Getting Started card contains six ordered lessons. Below the index, a Handbook groups deeper reference topics, followed by courses and books.

Why Dovetail ranks first overall

It has the strongest single captured research workspace: an explicit time range, a chart of named themes, selected theme and data-point counts, and a linked list for inspection. That structure can connect simulation results to the runs behind them.

TaskBest referenceWhy
Experiment catalogueSmartsheetA clearer aligned table and local search/filter toolbar.
Variant and metric framingStatsigMost direct testing language; its captured metrics view is only a perspective mockup.
Run progressBuildkiteNamed stages and an unmistakable overall pass state.
Reproducible analysisHexOnly candidate combining notebook/code, data, plots, and a dashboard in one capture.
Help navigationAstro DocsBest role separation and search, with a stable nested topic rail.
Deep technical pagesLucide DocsBest captured article with active section and an “On this page” outline.
First-run lessonLocalCanBest short numbered instructions followed by next steps.
Learning catalogueGlyphs TutorialsBest searchable/topic-filtered lesson index with a visible six-step starter path.

Use Dovetail for the analysis-workspace pattern, Astro Docs for the main help navigation, and LocalCan for the first-run lesson. Keep Dovetail’s chart-to-record relationship and replace its customer-feedback measures with biological metrics, conditions, units, seeds, and traceable runs. Its dark visual style and revenue labels do not transfer.

Close alternatives that were not shortlisted

Linear centers issue tracking and is very dark. Ghost focuses on creator subscriptions. Coda overlaps Smartsheet’s task table with less research-specific evidence. Kaggle is a useful learning-community reference, but does not show a run-and-results workspace. None presents a complete scientific setup flow.

ACTUAL REUSABLE SOURCE / INSPO MCP

Three starting templates

Breadcrumb navigation

Visible location within an experiment or Guide hierarchy. Use Experiments / batch name / run name. Keep global phase navigation visible. Replace placeholder destinations and mark the current page.

MCP: get_reference_jsx(nav, breadcrumb)
Saved source: NavBreadcrumb.jsx

Search navigation

A wide search field with quiet utility links. Use for gene, experiment, or Guide lookup in a clearly labeled scope. Add a real input label, search handling, and mobile navigation. The pictured shortcut is not wired in the source.

MCP: get_reference_jsx(nav, search-first)
Saved source: NavSearchFirst.jsx

Searchable help

Client-side filtering of visible question-and-answer rows. Use for short definitions and troubleshooting. Replace sample questions with scientific explanations; label the input, handle Enter, and announce result counts. It is not a full documentation search service.

MCP: get_reference_jsx(faq, search-led)
Saved source: FaqSearchLed.jsx

The source files require React, Tailwind, Inspo utility styles, and the returned CSS token aliases. They are reference components with sample content; labels, real destinations, keyboard behavior, and responsive behavior need application work. No application code was changed.

One clear research journey

Explore

Find biological context and examples.

Simulate

Configure, review, launch, and monitor.

Analyze

Interpret, compare with control, export.

Help remains visible

Guide is a fourth, permanent destination. Parameter explanations link to relevant sections. Students get a first-run lesson; experienced users can open the full technical reference immediately.

Prototype priorities

1 / Orientation
Labeled phases, selected experiment, permanent Guide, and breadcrumbs that explain the current location.

2 / First successful run
A worked example, understandable settings, a review summary, and stage names tied to actual execution.

3 / Scientific interpretation
Units, seeds, control, configuration, and uncertainty next to the plot; deeper analysis within reach.

The setup sequence, uncertainty display, and comparison with control are proposed scientific adaptations. The captures do not show a complete simulator wizard or validate these behaviors.

Compared 43 unique Inspo search matches across analytics, science, workflow, documentation, and experiment-catalog topics. Inspected 16 full-page captures, shortlisted nine, and retrieved three reusable sources from get_reference_jsx. Full tool responses and exact image URLs are in inspo-research.json.

Search results were deduplicated by Inspo screen slug. Rankings are editorial judgments, not measured usability scores. Automatic tags and color-role guesses were treated as heuristics; image inspection took precedence.

Five references are marketing previews; four are documentation or learning pages. Captures span May-September 2026. No end-to-end flow, accessibility compliance, or current product behavior was verified.
